title: Non-blocking onboarding and graceful role defaults

requirements.summary: Make missing-profile onboarding non-blocking so users can access the app and optionally complete profile setup later.
acceptanceCriteria: After logging in with Internet Identity, the user can reach the Invoices page even if no user profile exists yet.
The app does not show an always-open modal that prevents clicking elsewhere when the profile is missing.
If profile setup UI is shown, it includes a clear non-destructive option to defer/skip and continue using the app.

file_operations.description: Remove the always-open blocking onboarding modal behavior by changing RootLayout so it does not unconditionally render ProfileSetupModal when userProfile is null; instead, render a non-blocking prompt entry point (e.g., banner/toast/inline callout) that lets the user continue using the app. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Refactor the profile setup UI so it can be opened/closed by the user (controlled open state via props) and add a clear English "Skip for now" / "Not now" action that dismisses without saving; ensure it no longer prevents interacting with the rest of the app by default (no forced open=true, no outside-click prevention for the non-blocking flow). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a small, non-blocking prompt component shown only when authenticated and userProfile is null, offering "Set up profile" (opens ProfileSetupModal) and "Skip for now" (dismisses prompt) actions, with all user-facing copy in English. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Wire the new ProfileSetupPrompt into the authenticated layout (e.g., below the header within the main container) so it is visible but non-blocking when profile is missing; ensure navigation to Invoices remains available and usable even if the profile is not yet created. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Handle missing/unknown role gracefully by defaulting to non-admin UI and avoiding crashes or indefinite loading.
acceptanceCriteria: When authenticated and role is missing/undefined, the app defaults to the non-admin navigation and does not crash or get stuck on a loading state.
Admin-only navigation items remain hidden unless the resolved role is explicitly "admin".
User-facing text for any new prompts/buttons/toasts is in English.

file_operations.description: Adjust role fetching state handling so role can be treated as optional: default to a non-admin role when role data is missing/undefined or when role fetching fails, and ensure isLoading does not remain true indefinitely on role-query failure; keep admin detection strict (only true when role === "admin"). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Update index/landing routing logic to remain usable while role is loading or missing: avoid blocking the app behind a loading screen longer than necessary, and ensure non-admin default routes (Invoices) render when role is unknown/undefined; keep admin-only rendering guarded by explicit "admin" role. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Ensure navigation rendering remains stable when userRole is missing/undefined by treating it as non-admin for UI purposes (admin items hidden unless role is explicitly "admin"), and ensure user identity display does not crash when profile is absent. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
